title: artifact-share-metadata/v2
description: Owned YAML frontmatter on content/shares/<hash>.mdx with an explicit v2 identifier. Producers quote the hash as a YAML string, including numeric-only hashes. Body, component props, unknown frontmatter, and original asset bytes are authored content; historical publications have no automatic upgrade. Existing repository consumers must pass the explicit local cli.ts upgrade before generating v2 pages; consumer code upgrades never rewrite published pages.
